title: Effects of combined surface treatments of aluminium nanoparticle on its corrosion resistance before and after inclusion into an epoxy coating
notes: Spine: need -> hypothesis -> Ce/APTES modification + pH/APTES/loading sweep -> Ce conversion dip -> APTES grafting -> epoxy coating on steel -> partial Ce coverage / grafted silane -> non-polar surface -> particle corrosion in acid (Ce+silane joint; H2 trapping alternative) -> dispersion in epoxy (NH2-epoxy MEC) -> barrier MEC -> impedance ranking -> salt spray; parallel branch adhesion loss -> conclusion. Side: EDS Ce vs pH -> pH 3.8 down-select; H2-trapping alternative; 2 wt% guidance. Audits: o5 Ce 3d not resolved in survey inset, o20 Al 2p metal peak above oxide BE, o21 O1s component heights reverse the text ordering, o10 no visible 140-min latency, o22 cavities in S3. Packet figure ids: F4..F12 are paper Figs 5..13; paper Fig. 4 (FTIR, cited in linked text) is absent. F10 crops carry OCR cue XRD on EIS Bode plots; EIS nodes cite F10 with panel_ids []. Tables 3-7 not in packet. Not in graph: F1a (image_note o1), F3 sizes (image_note o4), F11 M series.
